course_title: Advanced Flutter State Management & Clean Architecture

sections.description: Understanding the core concepts of state, declarative UI, and comparing traditional approaches.

steps.step_title: Introduction to State and Declarative UI
learning_objectives: Define state in the context of Flutter
Understand declarative vs imperative UI paradigms
Master the underlying mechanism of InheritedWidget
Build a custom lightweight state container

sections.description: Mastering the BLoC library for scalable and testable applications.

learning_objectives: Understand when to use Cubit vs BLoC
Implement event-driven state transitions
Manage debouncing, throttling, and concurrent requests
Handle errors and network failures gracefully

sections.description: Leveraging Riverpod for compile-safe and dependency-injection-friendly state management.

learning_objectives: Explore Provider, StateProvider, and StateNotifierProvider
Understand auto-dispose and family modifiers
Handle loading, error, and data states declaratively
Implement pull-to-refresh and pagination

sections.description: Structuring large-scale applications using Clean Architecture principles.

learning_objectives: Understand Domain, Data, and Presentation layers
Enforce dependency rule boundaries
Implement business logic inside UseCases
Design robust Entity and Data Model mappings

sections.description: Ensuring code quality through comprehensive testing and robust error handling.

learning_objectives: Write unit tests for Cubits and UseCases using Mocktail
Test widget reactivity and state changes
Configure GetIt for service location
Implement global error handling and logging
